**Allowed origins** (worker/src/index.ts, `app.use('*', cors({...}))`, lines ~19–30): the `origin` callback accepts exact match `http://localhost:4200`, plus any origin ending in `.pages.dev` or `.workers.dev` (any subdomain depth). Everything else returns `null` (blocked).

**To add a new custom domain:** edit the `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` (~line 21), adding an `origin === 'https://your-domain.com'` (or `.endsWith('.your-domain.com')`) check inside the `if` condition. Note: this must be a function, not an array entry — Hono's CORS array matching is exact-string only, so wildcard subdomains require the function form already used here. See `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md §4 (CORS)` for more detail.
